name: sitting one leg external stretch
description: A seated stretch that opens one hip by turning the leg outward.
instructions: Sit on the floor and bend one leg so the foot rests against the opposite thigh.
Lean your chest forward over the bent leg while pressing the knee toward the floor until the hip stretches.
Hold for 20-30 seconds, feeling a gentle pull rather than pain.
Release slowly and repeat, switching sides if the stretch is one sided.
